[[File:PodracingQuarterly.jpg|thumb|250px|An issue of the magazine]]
'''''Podracing Quarterly''''' was a quarterly magazine about [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]], of which [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] was apparently an avid reader. [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]] wrote for it as the feature columnist after he wrangled his way into the publication. His participatory writing led him to become a podracer on his own, with his fans following his exploits.
